Metadata.title: Ergodic · Software studio in Košice
Metadata.description: Web, mobile and automation for businesses in Slovakia and the EU. We draw the options first, then build the one that fits you.

Hero.titleB: We build the one that’s yours.
Hero.lead: Web, mobile and automation for businesses in Slovakia and beyond. We draw the options first, then build the one that fits you, not the average.
Hero.leadShort: Web, mobile and automation. We draw the options first, then build the one that fits you.
Hero.caption: 7 paths considered · 1 chosen

Method.title: From survey to a system that keeps working.

survey.title: Survey
survey.body: We learn how your business actually runs: people, tools and where the money flows.

variants.title: Variants
variants.body: We draw the options side by side, from off-the-shelf to custom, with what each one costs.

build.title: Build
build.body: We build the chosen one in small releases, so you use it long before it is finished.

maintain.title: Maintain
maintain.body: A monthly retainer keeps it running and growing, with one person who knows the whole system.

web.title: Web & e-shops
web.body: Sites and stores that sell, in Slovak and English, fast on every phone.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.body: One codebase for iOS and Android, published in both stores.
mobile.specs: React Native · Expo|App Store · Google Play|Push · Offline

automation.title: Automation & AI
automation.body: Workflows that run themselves, with a person where it matters.

care.title: Care & retainers
care.body: Hosting, updates and small features every month, from one contact.

Drawings.title: Every project is a path study.
Drawings.lead: What we considered, what we built, and why.

zwicker.result: Multilingual site with its own CMS

qrplatby.result: SEPA QR payments for Slovak small businesses

Products.title: Our own drawings.
Products.body: Reservations and prepaid ticketed events for restaurants. Guests pay when they book, and the money goes straight to the restaurant’s own account.

Studio.title: Roman Denysov, founder.
Studio.body: Software engineer based in Košice. [N] years building React and React Native products for teams from local restaurants to international companies. You talk to the person who draws the options and writes the code.
